The Critical Entangled Singularity Stabilizer eats §ddense variants only§r: plain steam is first pressed a thousandfold by the manipulator, then pressed again here into a §dcritical singularity§r — dense is the ticket, critical the trophy.

It is a slow craft: sipping dense steam mouthful by mouthful until the vault is full, with the whole chain's priciest point at this machine's far end; rates live in the tooltip. If your fortune is thin, get the entangler's mass-production line humming first.

§3Critical is a whole steam age pressed into a point.§r
